items.description: Done when: the scraper walks the server-side date-filtered listing inside the Horizon only (hard page cap, fail loud), every emitted occurrence passes the shared Horizon predicate, listing/HTTP fetches run behind a named test seam with fixtures (frozen clock, patched sleeps), each run records pages/cards/unique-details/details/emitted and warns below half the trailing median, and the registration-contract test plus suite-index entry are green alongside python tests, lint, feed validation, and database tests.
items.notes: Done. Added scrapers/wfiu_community_calendar.py (Pattern A: name=WFIU Community Calendar, domain=ipm.org, timezone=America/Indiana/Indianapolis, source_url=listing): walks ?f1=<today00:00Ms>-<horizonMs>&p=1..N, reads the rendered '1 of N', PAGE_CAP=80 raises, one detail fetch per unique URL (DETAIL_CAP=500 raises) for brightspot.contentId, emits one event per occurrence card, and re-checks every dtstart with the shared Horizon predicate. Module-level _fetch_html/_now seams + fixtures in tests/fixtures/bloomington/; sleeps patched/frozen clock. Run history report/bloomington/wfiu_community_calendar.runs.json records pages/cards_fetched/unique_detail_urls/details_fetched/emitted and warns below 50% of the trailing-7-run card median. Added WFIU Community Calendar to source_priority.json aggregators and the pending_feeds.txt entry (needed so the new-scraper feed-validation rule passes; add_scraper.py's live test cannot run unattended, so item 4 owns the test-only page cap + docs). Pre-approved decisions (unattended): detail fetch included in the tracer so details_fetched is real and the seam covers both fetch kinds; card-only field mapping (item 3 enriches from detail); date binding leaves the Horizon predicate as the authoritative guard. 25 new tests; TEST_SUITE.md updated. Gates: pytest 209 pass, make lint-python clean, supabase test db pass, feed validation run against origin/main after commit.
items.title: WFIU 1: listing tracer bullet

items.description: Done when: dateless cards bind to the in-Horizon year (weekday-agreement rollover with warned fallback), time blocks yield timed city-zone events with literal late endings and midnight rollover, unparseable times degrade to all-day with a warning while unparseable dates raise after a small threshold, start-only events carry a one-hour duration, multi-day runs emit one timed event per day with no synthesized span, and identity/dedupe keys on content id plus date plus time block.
items.notes: Done. Time and identity hardening in scrapers/wfiu_community_calendar.py. _bind_year now takes the Horizon date and binds a year-less month/day inside [today, horizon], preferring the year whose weekday agrees and warning (agreed=False) when it falls back to the earliest in-window candidate; unbindable dates log ERROR and raise once a run exceeds DATE_ERROR_THRESHOLD=3. _time_range gained a start-only branch (_START_ONLY) yielding a one-hour event, and _resolve_end turns a start==end block into one hour while leaving a genuine past-midnight end literal; _parse_card rolls the date forward rather than coercing to all-day. Multi-day run cards still emit exactly one same-day timed VEVENT (listing expansion trusted). Identity/dedupe now key on content id + occurrence date + normalized time block (_time_key), and fetch_events dedupes emitted UIDs so duplicate cards collapse while same-day matinee/evening showings stay distinct. 11 new tests in TestTimeAndIdentity plus the updated UID-shape test. Pre-approved decisions (unattended): a zero-duration block reads as start-only (1h) rather than a 24h rollover; unbindable (past or beyond-Horizon) dates count toward the loud threshold; dedupe keys on the UID, which encodes the triple. Gates: pytest 220 pass; make lint-python clean (ruff + 4 type checkers); validate_pr_feeds --base-ref origin/main pass; supabase test db pass.
